CanonicalKeywords.rationale: `{ CardKeyword.Innate, CardKeyword.Unplayable }` (Writhe.cs:10-14) == both flags. The Innate is the whole curse: an unplayable card guaranteed to be in the opening hand, so it costs a draw every single combat. As a CANONICAL keyword rather than an upgrade-added one it carries no downgrade-rebuild hazard -- contrast card/aggression, card/hello_world and card/juggling, which gain Innate on upgrade and do not re-seed it.

ctor.issue: Closed 2026-07-30 (tier-2 campaign): `Card.energy_cost` (`sts2_rl/cards/base.py`) now short-circuits on `self._energy_cost < 0` as its first check, returning the raw canonical value before consulting `_free_this_turn` / `_cost_this_turn` / `_cost_this_combat` / `_cost_delta_this_turn` -- mirrors `CardEnergyCost.GetWithModifiers`'s `if (_base < 0) return num;` short-circuit (`CardEnergyCost.cs:101-104`; the record's `:100-103` cite is one line of decompiler drift), which runs before any local or global modifier. All 29 unplayable curse/status/quest cards now set `self._energy_cost = -1` in `_init_vars` (previously 0), each verified individually against its own C# `base(-1, CardType.X, ...)` constructor -- no exceptions, no ascension-gated cost variant. Readers audit (every non-cards/ `energy_cost` hit read in context): combat play/auto-play/valid_actions/action-mask sites gate on `is_playable` first and never see -1; every global-modifier site routes through `hooks.modify_card_energy_cost`, whose dispatcher ends `return max(0, cost)` -- the sim's analogue of C#'s `Math.Max(0, GetWithModifiers(...))` in `GetAmountToSpend`/`GetResolved` (`CardEnergyCost.cs:134-141`) -- so what is SPENT and what the observation encoder reads (`full_env.py` card_features via `previews.py` preview_card_energy_cost) are byte-for-byte unchanged. The three previously-known readers (`relics/mummified_hand.py`, `potions.py` TouchOfInsanity, `cards/event_cards.py` Enlightenment) remain correct, confirmed by unit tests. NOT closed here: `selectors.py`'s `scripted_card_selector` 'to_draw_top' purpose (Headbutt/Thinking Ahead) ranks by raw `card.energy_cost` unclamped -- a sim-only heuristic with no C# analogue; a curse in a Headbutt-eligible discard pile now ranks below-cost instead of tying at 0. No test exercises it; filed in GAP-QUEUE.md's 'Named work with no entry of its own'. New pins: test/test_unplayable_cost.py.  The text it replaced read: CURSE / CURSE / NONE map exactly. The canonical energy cost is -1 in C# and 0 in the sim. `CardEnergyCost.GetWithModifiers` returns early on `_base < 0` (CardEnergyCost.cs:100-103), so the game's unplayable card is immune to every cost modifier; the sim runs a base of 0 through the full modifier chain (cards/base.py:324-353, moved from the historical :222-232 citation). Only what is READ diverges. Same mechanism and same verdict as card/ascenders_bane's ctor entry (rule 3). DORMANT: every ported cost reader filters `> 0` or skips `<= 1`, and events/infested_automaton.py filters pool_card_ids(), which holds no curses or statuses.

OnPlay.rationale: Writhe.cs has no members beyond the two overrides -- no OnPlay, no OnTurnEndInHand, no vars. It does NOT override CanBeGeneratedByModifiers, so Writhe IS in the random-curse pool on both sides (the sim leaves the True default), unlike card/ascenders_bane, card/bad_luck, card/curse_of_the_bell, card/enthralled, card/folly, card/greed, card/poor_sleep and card/spore_mind.
